Jab Aaya-e-Baligh Tere Tewar Nazar Aaye.
Dunya Mein Ali Sab Se Qad Aawar Nazar Aaye.
Soraj Ki Kahin Dhop Kahin Ishq Ka Saya.
Ik Waqt Mein Do Tarha Ke Manzar Nazar Aaye.

2
Ik Noor Ke Do Tukray They Aaina-e-Khum Mein.
Jis Rukh Se Bhi Dekha Woh Barabar Nazar Aaye.
Ayelan Wilayat Ka Hazaron Ne Suna Tha.
Mangi Jo Shahadat Tu Bahatar Nazar Aaye.

3
Hathoon Se Mere Choot Gaya Saghar-e-Kausar.
Kausar Pe Jo Khud Saqi-e-Kausar Nazar Aaye.
ALLAH Re Yeh Mojza-e-Noor-e-Wilayat.
Andhon Ko Bhi Maidan Mein Haider Nazar Aaye.

4
Nabiyon Ko Jahan Dhond Raha Tha Main Wahan Par.
Fizza Nazar Aayi Kabhi Qanbar Nazar Aaye.
Keh Dena Keh Behlool Hai Yeh:MIR HASAN: Bhi.
Dunya Jo Uthaye Hoye Pathar Nazar Aaye.

from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/jab-aaya-e-baligh-tajpoints-7a7864d22765c88bb097.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---', 2)[2]
_, yaml, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = yaml.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
def words(s):
    return re.findall(r\"[\\w-]+\", s.casefold())
assert words(old) == words(roman)
for text, digits in ((roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')):
    blocks = text.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 4
    for block, digit in zip(blocks, digits):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        assert len(lines) == 5 and lines[0].strip() == digit
        assert all(line.strip() and not line.endswith('.') for line in lines[1:])
print('Verified four stanzas of four verses in both scripts and unchanged Roman wording.')
PY
